text.25:75: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,
text.27:6: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware.
text.28:80: But those who had been given knowledge said: Woe unto you! The reward of Allah for him who believeth and doeth right is better, and only the steadfast will obtain it.
text.41:35: But none is granted it save those who are steadfast, and none is granted it save the owner of great happiness.
text.76:11: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
